page.title: Team
page.intro: Invite your colleagues: each one signs in with their own email address, with the role you give them.
page.adminOnlyText: The account holder and the administrators manage the team and its roles.

roleHint.ADMIN: Everything, including the subscription, the organisation and the team
roleHint.RECRUITER: Jobs, candidates, interviews, messages and missions
roleHint.REVIEWER: Reads candidates and gives an opinion
